inspiration.source_location: T-SQL/09 Grouping Sets/02 GROUP BY CUBE.sql:5-12,22-24
inspiration.observed_pattern: A reporting query uses CUBE over two dimensions to produce the detail grouping, each single-dimension subtotal, and the grand total in one result set.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a campaign-sales report with region and product-line dimensions. Because MariaDB 10.11.7 and MySqweel do not expose native CUBE, the four CUBE grouping sets are expressed as ordered UNION ALL branches: detail, region subtotal, product-line subtotal, and grand total. T-SQL USE, GO, dbo qualification, and source tables are not copied.

fixture_notes: Four campaign-sales rows produce every grouping level for two dimensions. summary_level makes subtotal NULLs explicit and distinguishes them from stored dimension values.
determinism_notes: Sale IDs, dimensions, amounts, fixed grouping branches, labels, and final ordering are fixed. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE cube_sales (sale_id INT PRIMARY KEY, region_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, product_line VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, amount INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT region_code, product_line, SUM(amount) AS total_amount, 'detail' AS summary_level FROM cube_sales GROUP BY region_code, product_line UNION ALL SELECT region_code, NULL, SUM(amount), 'region-total' FROM cube_sales GROUP BY region_code UNION ALL SELECT NULL, product_line, SUM(amount), 'product-total' FROM cube_sales GROUP BY product_line UNION ALL SELECT NULL, NULL, SUM(amount), 'grand-total' FROM cube_sales ORDER BY summary_level, region_code, product_line

checks.sql: SELECT sale_id, region_code, product_line, amount FROM cube_sales ORDER BY sale_id
